title: Refusal direction ablation
model: 13 open-source chat models up to 72B parameters
system: white-box activation interventions on chat models

cells.title: Source
body: Andy Arditi, Oscar Obeso, Aaquib Syed, Daniel Paleka, Nina Panickssery, Wes Gurnee, and Neel Nanda submitted "Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction" to arXiv on June 17, 2024.
The paper studied refusal behavior in open-source chat models using activation-space interventions.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The authors reported that refusal behavior was mediated by a one-dimensional subspace across the models they studied.
Erasing the identified direction from residual stream activations prevented refusal on harmful instructions, while adding the direction elicited refusal on harmless instructions.

cells.output: The paper reported that erasing the direction prevented refusal on harmful instructions.
The paper reported that adding the direction elicited refusal on harmless instructions.

The archive does not reproduce harmful prompts or completions from the paper.
